method: All 27 pages inspected, four original-resolution player samples plus context per block. Ordinary fixed-barrel shooters throughout the displayed samples, including basic, machine-gun, twin, quad, octagonal and rear-thrust gun configurations. No independent automatic turret or player-controlled drone attachment observed. Other players may use those classes. Native damage flashes retained. Class-bar crops are unverified visual assistance, not OCR evidence. Full-frame sample, duplicate and continuity audits remain required.
